title: The Secret Place Nighttime Prayer Wall: Drop Your Requests
body_text:
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want. He makes me to lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside still waters (Psalm 23:1-2).

Beloved community, if you are carrying a heavy burden, physical sickness, or emotional exhaustion tonight, you do not walk alone. Drop your prayer request below. Our editorial prayer intercessors pray over every single name. Write 'AMEN' to claim His peace.
